Learn about Ramp Stack Stack has finally automated what we all knew was coming with AI, but it did it in a reliable and consistent manner. Tyler Otto President, Specialized Accounting Read their story Keep your finance team focused on strategy. Let agents handle the busywork. Learn about Ramp Intelligence Gone are the days of scrambling to chase receipts, manually coding really large data sets. All of that has been automatically addressed throughout the month in real time. Lauren Feeney Controller, Perplexity Read their story AI that learns from your team. And gets smarter with every team that joins. Learn about Policy Agents We have thousands of transactions a month, and the number of manual edits I make has dropped drastically. Ramp's AI just keeps getting smarter every week. Neusha Sayadian Fractional CFO, Valence See what agents can automate. Get a personalized look at the busy work agents can take off your team's plate. View Demo Scale the team. Shrink the paperwork. You had a bureaucracy. Now you have a business again. Set user access on autopilot. Provision cards, permissions, and limits automatically based on role, location, department and custom fields. Enterprise Solutions One platform for all your global spend. Issue cards in 30+ currencies and reimburse employees in local currencies, including pounds, euros, yen, and pesos. Global Spend Management 70,000 teams and counting We've got the receipts. View Demo Shannon McCormick International Workplace Experience Lead, Notion As soon as I texted my first Ramp receipt, I realized Ramp is a game-changer. It’s incredibly intuitive. Heather Bruzus Principal Accountant, Mindbody & ClassPass We got positive feedback, which just doesn't happen very often. That proved this was the right decision. Tzu-San Hung Head of Strategic Finance, Notion Beautiful tools use beautiful tools. Matteo Franceschetti CEO, Eight Sleep Ramp was a complete game changer. It's a single platform that can handle every aspect of our spending. Christine Mimnagh-Fleming Sr. Manager, Finance Transformation, Shopify Ramp is so intuitive, people get it right away. Carey Peek CFO, KIPP Nashville Public Schools Implementing Ramp has been my biggest win as CFO. Employees love it and often go out of their way to tell me so. Mayor Neil Bradshaw Mayor, City of Ketchum, ID Ramp gives us the ability to make more informed financial policy decisions. It was one of the best decisions we've ever made. Bret Taylor CEO, Sierra It's almost like we're a more self-actualized company because everyone is just working on what we do differently. Michael Bohn Head of Business Operations, Foursquare The average person can figure Ramp out without training. That’s what drives 100% adoption. Ben Whipple Director of Public Works, City of Ketchum, ID I snap a picture of the receipt, Ramp handles the rest like magic, and I move on. Michael Litwin VP Controller, Virgin Voyages Before Ramp it was a process from the dark ages. We had people just doing expenses full-time. It was miserable. Staci Robinson AP Manager, Pair Eyewear Ramp's AI has given me a better work-life balance. I have more time for my family now that the AI handles much of the work I used to do manually. Irish Rose Controller, Eight Sleep Closing the books with Ramp is effortless. Andrew Clarke SVP Finance, Studs We've consolidated four platforms into one with Ramp. Jason Penegar VP Controller, Boys & Girls Clubs of America The Ramp journey has been incredible. A flawless implementation… Sarah Bird Controller, Seed Health It's rare to feel like a company and a team is a partner, and that they really want to understand what you need. That's what we've experienced with Ramp. Carolynn Yipp Assistant Controller, Poshmark It's very easy to use, very intuitive, and requires almost zero training. Time is money. Save both.
